raw_query: Layers: 'hospitals' is a point layer of hospitals and clinics in Istanbul, Turkey, in EPSG:4326. 'mahalle' is a polygon layer of Istanbul neighbourhood (mahalle) boundaries, also in EPSG:4326. For each mahalle, determine how far it is from the nearest hospital or clinic, and identify which mahalle are underserved because their nearest facility is too far away.
_slimmed: Copied from arazshah/smart-spatial-istanbul-health-access: output feature geometry set to null and _target_properties reduced to osm_id, osm_type, name, amenity, healthcare. Everything else is unchanged. Geometry: join osm_id to data/processed/mahalle.geojson.
